entities.name: Lathril
entities.description: An elf swordswoman who becomes a god after a crucible, losing much of her sight, and who is chosen by a copper wolf companion.

entities.name: Lukya
entities.description: The copper wolf with turquoise eyes who becomes Lathril's guide and companion, sent by the wolf lord.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: The divine being who sends wolf children to his chosen.

entities.name: Yadira
entities.description: The leader of Lathril's elven clan who tells her she has been summoned.

entities.name: Lyana
entities.description: A blind girl of about eleven or twelve with aqua eyes, attacked by draugr after her wolf is stolen.

entities.name: Kit
entities.description: Lyana's small gold wolf, stolen by the draugr and chained at their camp until Lathril frees her.

entities.name: Giant wolf
entities.description: A giant wolf with glowing eyes who thanks Lathril for rescuing one of his children and gives her a gift.

entities.name: Draugr
entities.description: Blue-bladed attackers who steal Lyana's wolf and chain it at their camp.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A magical path between realms that Lathril and Lukya walk through.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The realm whose light might color the snow in the new realm.

events.summary: Lathril emerges from her crucible changed, taking on the mantle of godhood.
events.quote: She was taking on the mantle of godhood.

events.summary: Lathril discovers the price of godhood: her sight has narrowed to a blur.
events.quote: Instead of seeing the world as she had always seen it, her focus had narrowed.

events.summary: Lathril wakes to find a copper wolf in her bed, evidently sent by Sarulf.
events.quote: she found herself face-to-face with a pair of turquoise eyes, set in the face of a beautiful copper wolf

events.summary: The wolf leads Lathril to the door where a harness hangs, and Lathril follows her out into the village.
events.quote: But the wolf led her to the tall green door that led out into the village.

events.summary: Yadira meets Lathril and tells her she and the wolf are summoned to deal with a problem between worlds.
events.quote: you've been summoned to deal with a problem.

events.summary: Lathril tells the wolf to take her where she is most needed, and an Omenpath opens.
events.quote: Lathril followed as an Omenpath opened ahead of them, and they stepped through without a pause or a question.

events.summary: Lathril hears a scream and rushes into a clearing with the wolf to defend a girl.
events.quote: The wolf didn't react until she was ready, then they charged ahead

events.summary: Lathril fights the attacking draugr, stabs one and knocks out another.
events.quote: with a swift kick to the head, the other target was out for the count

events.summary: Lyana says the draugr stole her wolf.
events.quote: They took my wooooolf!

events.summary: Lathril binds the two downed foes and learns the girl is Lyana and her wolf is Kit.
events.quote: finally resorting to binding their hands and feet with belts and shoelaces

events.summary: Lathril returns Lyana to her village and tells the elder she found one of their children.
events.quote: I believe I've found one of your children,

events.summary: Lathril realizes retrieving the stolen wolf is the quest she was sent on.
events.quote: This was the quest she had been sent on.

events.summary: Lathril finds the draugr camp with Kit chained to a stake.
events.quote: At the end of that chain was a wolf, a small one.

events.summary: Lathril waits for the men to sleep and works the lock on Kit's chain.
events.quote: Lathril successfully worked the lock on the pup's chain

events.summary: A waking draugr catches Lathril and she brawls her way free and flees.
events.quote: Her instincts took over.

events.summary: Lost in the forest, Lathril finds the giant wolf in a glade with the two wolves bowing to him.
events.quote: Ahead of her, a giant wolf curled up in the middle of a glade, and the two wolves with whom she had escaped were bowing low to him.

events.summary: The giant wolf names her companion Lukya and accepts Lathril's service.
events.quote: You have accepted the one that I sent you. Her name is Lukya.

events.summary: As a gift, the giant wolf lets any of Lathril's kind safely walk his lands and speak with his beasts.
events.quote: any of your kind may safely walk my lands and communicate with my beasts

events.summary: Kit is returned to Lyana and they tumble together in the village.
events.quote: Kit, the little wolf, ran full bore into her person.

events.summary: Lathril walks back through the Omenpath with her new wolf companion.
events.quote: The Omenpath was opening, and Lathril walked through it

relations.note: Lukya becomes Lathril's companion and guide.
relations.quote: with her new friend safely at her side

relations.note: Lathril assumes the wolf is one of Sarulf's wolf children sent to his chosen.
relations.quote: There was only one divine being that sent wolf children to his chosen, and that was Sarulf.

relations.note: She fights the draugr attacking Lyana.
relations.quote: with a swift kick to the head, the other target was out for the count
and my wolf is named Kit.
